method: Independently read ARM64 instructions, re-disassemble the exact executable with LLVM, match all nine existing wrapper/export ASM instruction maps, and inspect exact update/WM/strict-helper ranges. Missing source callback symbols are compiler inlining, not guard absence.

consumers.result: Refusal sets w0=0 at 0x10133c32c; native result and refusal share byte output 0x10133c330.
Refusal sets w0=0 at 0x10133c3a4; native result and refusal share byte output 0x10133c3a8.

consumers.cache: Guard refusal jumps beyond all inlined cache dirty/allocation branches, including 0x10133b9b8, 0x10133ba98, 0x10133bb70, 0x10133bc48, 0x10133bd90.

generated_argument_forwarding.add_wrappers: Incoming C x0 saved x21; incoming reports x1 saved x19; CTX_data_main(C) result transferred x1; x0 restored from x21, x2 points to sp+8 fresh-ID slot, x3 from x19 at each guard. Native calls use fresh slot, reports x19 and count x20.
generated_argument_forwarding.clear_wrapper: C x20 and reports x19; CTX_data_main result x1; guard x0=x20, x2=sp+8,x3=x19.
generated_argument_forwarding.validate_wrapper: C x22 and reports x21; CTX_data_main result x1; guard x0=x22,x2=sp+8,x3=x21. Native verbose/clean_customdata remain saved w19/w20.
generated_argument_forwarding.material_validator_wrapper: C x20 and reports x19; CTX_data_main result x1; guard x0=x20,x2=sp+8,x3=x19.
generated_argument_forwarding.update_wrapper: 0x10133c19c gets Main from original C; 0x10133c1a0-1b4 forward x0=mesh,x1=Main,x2=C(saved x20),x3=reports(saved x19),x4/x5=boolean parameters before tail at 0x10133c1c8. Actual callback preserves Main x1 and reports x3 when setting x0=C and x2=sp+8 before guard.
generated_argument_forwarding.add_early_admission: CMP count, CCMP edit_mesh with NZCV #0 when count is zero, and B.EQ select the guard only for nonzero count and no edit_mesh. Other cases tail into native admission. Actual ED_mesh_verts_add 0x101c63234 checks edit_mesh before report tail 0x101c63274; zero count check follows at 0x101c6327c.

export_absence_before_capture.global: llvm-nm gives _G at 0x106d74028. Pinned BKE_global.hh starts Global with Main *main and defines G_MAIN=(G).main; ADRP/add/ldr 0x101265f20-28 reads that exact address.
export_absence_before_capture.fallback: ORR x8,x0,x1 at 0x101265f1c and CSEL x8,x1,x9,ne at 0x101265f30 select G.main only when original C and Main are both null.
export_absence_before_capture.query: 0x101265f80-94 save original C x20/Main x21/ID-slot x22/operation x23, set x1=owner_main and x2=0; call WM_next at 0x101265f98 before strict capture.
export_absence_before_capture.strict_original_arguments: After query, 0x101265f9c-fa4 restore operation/Main/ID-slot, 0x101265fac restores original C. False at 0x101265fb0 reaches 0x101265f44 and strict call 0x101265f5c with original arguments. True reaches return without entering strict identity capture.

wm_null_output_no_cancel.output_identity: Incoming x2 saved x24 at 0x100b51440, saved sp+0x10 at 0x100b51528 and restored 0x100b51840 (or stays x24 on empty-manager path).
wm_null_output_no_cancel.admission: 0x100b51458-6c reject null/non-active Main; 0x100b51470-80 allow null C and otherwise validate CTX_data_main. Context-manager membership is checked at 0x100b514d0 and context unchanged at 0x100b51514/0x100b51848. Operator handler type/serial, native registration/lifetime and duplicate owner refusal remain at 0x100b517a4-0x100b51828.
wm_null_output_no_cancel.branch: Found owner w26 becomes 1 at 0x100b517cc/0x100b51824. 0x100b51854 CMP x24,0; 0x100b51858 CSET w8,eq; 0x100b5185c EOR w21,w26,1; 0x100b51860 ORR w8,w8,w21; 0x100b51864 TBNZ w8,0 to 0x100b51b00. Thus null output bypasses cancellation and returns !found_owner through ordinary cleanup and 0x100b516f4 AND w0,w21,1.
wm_null_output_no_cancel.excluded_calls: CTX_create is later at 0x100b518f4, strict native owner teardown at 0x100b51940 and CTX_free at 0x100b5194c. Null-output query cannot reach those calls after owner scan.

strict_fresh_identity: After nonnull-output WM drain at 0x101266380, UID lookup 0x1012663f4 is followed by address comparison 0x101266404 and current ID name-type comparison 0x101266414. Library UID lookup 0x101266440 is followed by address comparison 0x10126644c and explicit ID_LI type check 0x101266460. Override-state match remains at 0x10126648c; fresh primary ID writes to caller slot at 0x101266498. These reads occur after the completed drain.

preserved_recorded_compiled_audits.weight_cancel: weight-cancel-compiled.json status passed; recorded native wpaint_cancel at 0x101dc5000 loads customdata x2 and tail-calls paint_stroke_cancel at 0x101dc5004

limits: Bounded guard refusal, argument forwarding, fresh-ID reload and null-output absence-query call-order review. No complete global CFG/reentrancy/termination proof.
WM can retire replacement owners within one drain; strict RNA identities revalidate after that completed drain.
No complete WM/UIKit execution, native cancellation rollback, GPU cache effect or device acceptance proof.
Production source, native build and package were not changed or rebuilt by this review.
